title: The Moonrise Chorus
summary: You have the Golden Maraca. Take it home to Grandmother Pondwhistle, and stay for the music.

goals.say: The band strikes up the moment she lifts the maraca: flutes, bongos, guitars, a bass made of a barrel. Then she puts it in your hands. 'It's yours. We've a spare. Keep the beat for us out there, wherever you go.'
goals.name: Grandmother Pondwhistle

threats.name: Grandmother Pondwhistle
threats.target_line: Is that...? Oh. Oh, you darling thing. Bufo! BUFO!
